question: Mangal starts from Point A and walks 14 m towards north. He takes a right turn, walks 9 m and then takes a right turn, walks 37 m, reaches Point B and stops. Jayanti starts from Point Z which is 15 m towards the east of Point B. She walks 11 m towards east, takes a left turn, walks 42 m, turns left and walks 63 m, turns left and walks 19 m and stops at Point Y. What is the shortest distance between Point A and Point Y? (All turns are 90 degree turns only.)
solution:
According to the given information,
